note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The seal state is drawn exactly as supplied: 'altered' only shows a supplied alteration mark with the neutral changed-datum marker; nothing is said about what an alteration means, and no doctrine on tampering, admissibility or custody is drawn. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState.
